name: Coral Eyewear
verdict: A private UK company controlled by its founders, Calvin and George Bailey. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Coral Eyewear Ltd (Companies House 12033074, Canterbury, Kent). Its persons-with-significant-control register names Calvin Alan Bailey and George Calvin Bailey (each more than 25% but not more than 50%); the brand calls itself a family-run studio of father and son. No state in the chain; no human-rights finding against the company identified.
